author: Brian Wolford
attribution: Photo: Brian Wolford, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Haiti_drink_depot_shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

Product boxes (TAMPICO) are distractors; shopkeeper seated in front. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
